mapper.select: SELECT * FROM task_management WHERE status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('已完成', '执行失败', '部分完成', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_COMPLETED') ORDER BY task_id
mapper.update: UPDATE task_management SET status = '执行失败', finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), execution_evidence_complete = 0 WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('已完成', '执行失败', '部分完成', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'PARTIAL_COMPLETED'))

UPDATE migration_task SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{reason}, finished_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND (status IS NULL OR status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED'))

UPDATE scheduling_assignment a JOIN scheduling_plan p ON p.plan_id = a.plan_id SET a.status = 'FAILED', a.error_message = #{reason}, a.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE p.internal_task_id = #{taskId} AND p.status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'RUNNING') AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'RUNNING')
UPDATE scheduling_plan SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{reason}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE internal_task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'RUNNING')
